## Docs

Every page below is available as raw markdown.

- [Contributing](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/community/contributing.md): How to contribute to Ink.
- [License](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/community/license.md): License information.
- [Blade Components](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/blade-components.md): All available Blade components for building your blog frontend.
- [Configuration](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/configuration.md): Full configuration reference for Ink.
- [Filament Admin](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/filament-admin.md): Managing blog posts, categories, and tags in the Filament admin panel.
- [Host-Owned Views](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/host-owned-views.md): Render ink's controllers through views your app already owns, and control the preview edit link.
- [Languages](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/languages.md): Publish the same post in several languages with per-language URLs, hreflang and feeds.
- [Listing SEO](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/listing-seo.md): Per-page canonicals, titles, and metadata for listing routes.
- [MCP Tools](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/mcp-tools.md): 14 MCP tools for AI agent blog management.
- [MediaLibrary Integration](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/media-library.md): Opt-in featured-image upload via spatie/laravel-medialibrary.
- [Schema](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/schema.md): Automatic JSON-LD schema emission for posts and listings.
- [Search](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/search.md): Portable search across blog posts with a config-driven backend hook.
- [Tags Taxonomy](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/essentials/tags.md): Opt-in many-to-many tags taxonomy with admin UI and public archive.
- [Frontend Setup (headless)](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/getting-started/frontend-setup.md): Build your own blog frontend using the package's Blade components.
- [Installation](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/getting-started/installation.md): Install Ink in your Laravel application.
- [Public-routes mode](https://relaticle.github.io/ink/raw/ink/getting-started/public-routes-mode.md): Get a working blog at /blog without writing controllers — opt in via config flags.
